implementation: Ubuntu 22.04 Kernel Crypto API Cryptographic Module (CFB_AESNI_C)
description: The Linux kernel crypto API implementation provides cryptographic services to Linux kernel space software components and user space via the AF_ALG interface. The following cipher implementation is covered: CFB generic C non-optimized block mode using Intel AES-NI AES implementation.
